:::{#thm-deriv-sin}
#### Derivative of sine

For every [real](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $x$,
the [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) of the [sine](algebra-trigonometry.qmd#def-sine) [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) is:

$$\deriv{x}\sin x = \cos x$$
:::
